entries.title: Revelation of John 8:1
segments: As soon as the Lamb had broken the seventh seal, there was silence in Heaven for, it might be, half-an-hour.

entries.title: Revelation of John 8:2
segments: Then I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.

entries.title: Revelation of John 8:3
segments: Next, another angel came and stood at the altar with a golden censer in his hand; and a great quantity of incense was given to him, to mingle with the prayers of all Christ's People upon the golden altar before the throne.

entries.title: Revelation of John 8:4
segments: The smoke of the incense ascended, with the prayers of Christ's People, from the hand of the angel before God.

entries.title: Revelation of John 8:5
segments: Then the angel took the censer, and filled it with fire from the altar, and threw it down upon the earth; and there followed 'peals of thunder, cries, flashes of lightning,' and an earthquake.

entries.title: Revelation of John 8:6
segments: Then the seven angels holding the seven trumpets prepared to blow their blasts.

entries.title: Revelation of John 8:7
segments: The first blew; and there came hail and fire mixed with blood, and it fell upon the earth. A third part of the earth was burnt up, and a third of the trees, and every blade of grass.

entries.title: Revelation of John 8:8
segments: Then the second angel blew; and what appeared to be a great mountain, burning, was hurled into the sea. A third of the sea became blood,

entries.title: Revelation of John 8:9
segments: and a third part of all created things that are in the sea--that is, of all living things--died, and a third of the ships was destroyed.

entries.title: Revelation of John 8:10
segments: Then the third angel blew; and there fell from the heavens a great star, burning like a torch. It fell upon a third of the rivers and upon the springs.

entries.title: Revelation of John 8:11
segments: (The star is called 'Wormwood.') A third of the water became bitter as wormwood, and so bitter was the water that many died from drinking it.

entries.title: Revelation of John 8:12
segments: Then the fourth angel blew; and a third of the sun and a third of the moon and a third of the stars were blasted, so that a third of them was eclipsed, and for a third part of the day there was no light, and at night it was the same.

entries.title: Revelation of John 8:13
segments: And, in my vision, I heard an eagle flying in mid-heaven and crying in a loud voice--'Woe, woe, woe for all who live on the earth, at the other trumpet-blasts of the three angels who have yet to blow.'
